plugin.name: IntelEngine
plugin.description:
AI-powered NPC autonomy mod for Skyrim. Gives NPCs the ability to travel, perform tasks, and create dynamic story events powered by SkyrimNet's LLM integration.
Features: - Player-directed NPC tasks (GoToLocation, FetchPerson, DeliverMessage, SearchForActor, ScheduleMeeting, EscortTarget) - LLM Dungeon Master story events (seek_player, informant, road_encounter, ambush, stalker, message, quest) - Autonomous NPC social interactions (npc_interaction, npc_gossip) - All features configurable via MCM
Requirements: SKSE, SkyrimNet Beta 25 or newer, PapyrusExtender (po3), PapyrusUtil, MCM Helper

plugin.name: Legacy save converter and FAQ
plugin.description:
Continuing a playthrough from IntelEngine 3.5.2 or earlier? Select this to install the converter and player FAQ in Data\IntelEngine Tools. Starting a fresh game? You do not need conversion.
In MO2: right-click IntelEngine and choose Open in Explorer, then open IntelEngine Tools. In Vortex: your game's Data folder.
1. Close Skyrim. 2. Back up the matching .ess and .skse files and keep them together in the same folder. 3. Drag exactly one .ess onto Convert-IE-Save.bat in IntelEngine Tools; leave its matching .skse beside the save. 4. Load the new _IEconverted save (its matching _IEconverted.skse stays beside it).
Skyrim 1.6.1170 and 1.7.104 only; VR saves are not convertible. Tested on 3.5.2 saves; saves from older versions convert if their format matches and are refused otherwise. The tool cannot recover already-lost names. It leaves your originals untouched. Do not load an incomplete converted pair, mix original and converted files, or convert the same save again. Never load a converted save with 3.5.2 or earlier.
If your save folder is a link or junction (including redirected or OneDrive folders), copy the .ess/.skse pair to a normal folder first and drag the .ess from there.
Windows SmartScreen may warn because the tool is unsigned: choose More info → Run anyway.
Read FAQ.md in IntelEngine Tools for more guidance.
